svg.desc: Left: prefill runs all five prompt tokens through the model at once and writes their keys and values into the cache. Right: each decode step computes q, k, v for one new token, appends k and v as a sixth cache entry, and attends over all six. The cache size formula is 2 times layers times heads times head dimension times sequence times batch times bytes.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The KV cache: prefill once, then decode one token at a time

svg.text: Past keys and values never change under a causal mask, so store them.
